Package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp

Interface McpSubscription

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface McpSubscription extends AutoCloseable
Per-subscription queue handle minted by an McpSubscriptionBroker.

Deliberately named differently from the client-facing McpSubscriptionHandle (a distinct type in a separate client module/package): this is the server-side, broker-internal handle a v2 dispatch branch drains via take() to serialize change events onto its own stream.

Owns its own bounded, drop-oldest queue — it does not reuse org.apache.juneau.rest.server.sse.SseSubscription, whose constructor and offer(...) method are package-private to a different package. Only one thread should call take() concurrently on a given instance (matching the production single-pump-per-subscription usage): close()'s contract of interrupting a blocked take() tracks a single in-flight taker thread.

    • take

      McpChangeEvent take() throws InterruptedException
      Blocks until the next matching change event is available.

      Calling this on a subscription that is already closed throws InterruptedException immediately rather than blocking — load-bearing behavior for a pump's graceful-completion path, which relies on a closed-before-called take() failing fast instead of hanging forever waiting for an event that will never arrive.

      Returns:
      The next event.
      Throws:
      InterruptedException - If the wait was interrupted, including by a concurrent close(), or if this subscription was already closed before this call.
